run_bench_server: run the bench.py CLI to benchmark a llama.cpp server with k6 and generate metrics
test_server_startup: test the server startup and readiness check via is_server_listening and is_server_ready functions
summarize_bench_results: summarize k6 benchmark results into JSON and GitHub env files with rounded metrics
build_prometheus_plots: build matplotlib plots from Prometheus metrics for prompt and token processing times
review_bench_cli: review the bench.py CLI module with argparse for configurable llama.cpp server benchmarking
